title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I went from USA to Jeddah on April 2010. Answer ID: 35118 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1766/1241/L=1432) The arrangement of farewell ceremony for Hajis is not good as per the Shariah.
